20.name: Soldier at Fort of Geum-Ohee Castle [Jae-Ga]

maps.label: Wild: Fort
maps.name: Out of Town — Forsaken Fort area (World Map, zoomed)

p9.name: Doggebi Who Wants To Be a Friend with Humans (Person 9)

maps.label: Wild: Forest
maps.name: Out of Town — Forrest of Elements / Tower of Priest (World Map, zoomed)

maps.label: Wild: Cargo
maps.name: Out of Town — Jook-Suh Cargo / Geum-Oh Mine area (World Map, zoomed)

stages.title: Stage 1 — Narootuh starter batch
stages.where: Stay in Narootuh the whole stage.

steps.text: Kill Lower Class Demons for "Shee-Geun’s Message"
Kill Demon Plunderers for "Chun-SooIn’s Stirrup"

stages.title: Stage 2 — Narootuh ↔ Jook-Suh shuttle
stages.where: Do both quests back-to-back — same round trip.

steps.text: Kill Demon SpearHead for "Demon’s Strategic Map"

stages.title: Stage 3 — Demon Escort Archers
stages.where: Narootuh only.

steps.text: Kill Demon Escort Archers for 10x "Demon’s Bow"

stages.title: Stage 4 — Suicide Bombers
stages.where: Jook-Suh → Geum-Oh Mine → Jook-Suh.

steps.text: Kill Suicide Bombers for 10x "Suicide Bomber’s Oil"

stages.title: Stage 5 — Demon Carcass Scavenger combo
stages.where: Narootuh (accept) → Jook-Suh (accept + turn in) → Narootuh (turn in).

steps.text: Kill Big Handed Inhabitants for 15x tooth
Kill Demon Carcass Scavengers for 2x "Straw Rice"
Kill Demon Escort Archer/Soldier for 30x "Escort Soldier’s Head"
Kill Big Handed for "Big Handed Inhabitant’s Head"
Kill Demon Carcass Scavengers for "In-Pills Scabbard"

stages.title: Stage 6 — Accept and hold: Big Handed Warriors
stages.level: Lv 0 req., save the grind for Lv 15-16
stages.where: Geum-Oh Mine — quick stop, then move on.

stages.title: Stage 7 — Milk Wetch / White Peony loop + Carcass follow-up
stages.where: Jook-Suh ↔ Narootuh.

steps.text: Kill Big Handed Slaves — collect 22 Milk Wetch + 22 White Peony (10+10 now, 12+12 extra for Quest 9)
Kill Demon Carcass Scavengers for 25x "Demon’s Carcass" (same camp as Stage 5)

steps.label: Hand in stockpiled Milk Wetch/White Peony

stages.title: Stage 8 — Demon Soldier’s Teeth
stages.where: Geum-Oh Mine ↔ Jook-Suh.

steps.text: Kill Demon Soldiers for 20x "Demon Soldier’s Teeth"

stages.title: Stage 9 — Egg quest
stages.where: Narootuh → Jook-Suh → Narootuh.

steps.text: Kill Naughty Doggebi (Jook-Suh) for "Keg of Talisman"

stages.title: Stage 10 — Big Handed Warriors combo
stages.where: Geum-Oh Mine ↔ Narootuh ↔ Jook-Suh.

steps.text: Kill Big Handed Blue Warriors for 25x "Rice Cake" (grab Red Warrior/Head drops too)

stages.title: Stage 11 — Joo-Nong’s Gold
stages.where: Narootuh ↔ Geum-Oh Mine.

steps.text: Kill Demon Infantry for 30x "Joo-Nong’s Gold"

stages.title: Stage 12 — Bamboo Poles
stages.where: Geum-Oh Mine ↔ Jook-Suh.

steps.text: Kill Demon Throwing Soldiers for 30x "Piece of Bamboo Pole"

stages.title: Stage 13 — Wild Demon Soldiers
stages.where: Geum-Oh Mine.

steps.text: Kill Wild Demon Soldiers for 30x "Statue"

stages.title: Stage 14 — Demon Shock Troopers
stages.where: Jook-Suh ↔ Geum-Oh Mine.

steps.text: Kill Demon Shock Troopers for 30x "Ja-Gan’s Gold"

stages.title: Stage 15 — General Sae-Won’s chain
stages.where: Jook-Suh only — same NPC, three separate visits as you level up.

steps.text: Kill Demon Flag Bearers for 35x "Red Flag"
Kill Demon Water Dragons for 35x "Demon Water Dragon Head"
Kill Demon Band for 40x "Demon’s Drum"

stages.title: Stage 1 — Jook-Suh solo run
stages.where: Jook-Suh Cargo Station only — same routine, four times in a row.

steps.text: Kill Demon Armored Knight for 40x "Demon’s Armor"
Kill Hungry Demon Water Dragon for 40x "Bloodstained Clothes"
Kill Demon Water Dragon Predator for 40x "Demon Water Dragon Skin"
Kill Demon Mad Knight for 40x "Demon Mad Knight Head"

stages.title: Stage 2 — Job Change #1 + Trinket’s Quest
stages.where: Geum-Oh Mine, then the Fort — this is a big milestone stage.

steps.text: Find "Moon-Hee’s Doll" from Castoff Baby Ghost
Try to get "Demon Commander’s Head" from Demon Commander first, to save a trip
Find "Demon Commander’s Head" if you don’t have it yet
Find 100x "Sealed Talisman with Spirits" from any Ghosts
Find one head each: Devil Soldier, Devil Soldier Twin Blades, Devil Soldier Bow, Devil Soldier Sword, Devil Soldier Spear, Devil Soldier Sub-boss, 1st Devil Monster

stages.title: Stage 3 — Ghost beads at the Fort
stages.where: Temporary Fort of Geum-Ohee Castle, one side-trip to Geum-Oh Mine.

steps.text: Kill Ghost Of Young Man for "Wolf Tooth Necklace"
Kill Ghost Of Young Woman for 10x "Ghost Bead"
Kill Demon Commander for "Demon Troops Confidential Document" (same mob as Event Quest 8)
Kill Ghost Of Blacksmith for 10x "Blacksmith Bead"

stages.title: Stage 4 — More Fort ghost beads
stages.where: Fort, one side-trip to Geum-Oh Mine.

steps.text: Kill Ghost Guard for 10x "Ghost Guard Bead"
Kill Demon Dragon Commander for "Demon Water Dragon Commanders Skin"

stages.title: Stage 5 — Fellow Traveller / Sealed Troop
stages.where: Fort only.

steps.text: Kill Fellow traveller to the other world for 10x "Fellow Traveller Bead"
Kill Sealed ghost troop for 10x "Sealed Troop Bead"
Kill Devil Soldier With Bow for 10x "Devil Soldier’s Bow"

stages.title: Stage 6 — Devil Soldier’s Spear
stages.where: Fort only.

steps.text: Kill Devil Soldier’s Spear for 10x "Devil Soldier’s Spear"
Find "Green Crystal" from Devil Troops of Absorbing Green (on the way to d3, and around d1 gates)

stages.title: Stage 7 — To-Woo’s errand + Ghost Hunter masks
stages.where: Fort, with a trip out of town.

steps.text: Kill Devil Troop Of Pain for 100x "Devil Troop of Pain’s Mask"

stages.title: Stage 8 — Red Flag Leader’s errand + Ghost Hunter masks
stages.where: Fort → Narootuh → Geum-Oh Mine → Fort, then out of town.

steps.text: Kill Devil Troop Of Greed for 100x "Devil Troop of Greed’s Mask"

stages.title: Stage 9 — Seoung-Gill’s secret + Ghost Hunter masks
stages.where: Fort, with trips out of town.

steps.text: Kill Devil Troop Of Jealousy for 100x "Devil Troop of Jealousy’s Mask"

stages.title: Stage 10 — Hatred combo + Doggebi spirits
stages.where: Out of town + Fort + Forsaken Fort.

steps.text: Kill Devil Troop Of Hatred for "Rope"
Kill Devil Troop Of Hatred for 100x "Devil Troop of Hatred’s Mask" (same mob as Quest 41)
Find one spirit of each: Doggebi of Monster Face, Doggebi with a Gong, Drunken Doggebi, Doggebi with a Mask of Black Crow, Doggebi with a Mask of Black Panther, Giant Doggebi, Guardian of Doggebi

steps.label: Kill Chief of Angry Doggebi Troop for its dead body

stages.title: Stage 11 — Doll for a Doggebi friend + last mask
stages.where: Out of town + Fort.

steps.text: Kill Devil Troop Of Anger for "Defective Doggebi’s Doll"
Kill Devil Troop Of Madness for 100x "Devil Troop of Madness’ Mask"

stages.title: Stage 12 — Doggebi broom collection
stages.where: Out of town only, four NPCs in a row.

steps.text: Kill Doggebi Of Monster Face for its broom + 5x Blood of Big Handed
Kill Doggebi with Gong for its broom + 5x Blood of Big Handed
Kill Drunken Doggebi for its broom + 5x Blood of Big Handed
Kill Doggebi with Mask of Black Crow for its broom + 5x Blood of Big Handed

stages.title: Stage 1 — Lv 50 kickoff: 2nd Job Change + Doggebi grind
stages.where: Out of town, then the Fort — big milestone stage.

steps.text: Find "Doggebi with Mask of Black Panther’s Broom" and 5x "Blood of Big Handed" from Doggebi with Mask of Black Panther
Pick your job — this choice is permanent, confirm twice
Kill 50 Giant Doggebi
Kill 50 Guardian of Doggebi, then kill "Angry Doggebi of Monster Face" (spawns every 2h since last kill, near D1 / the hollow tree — only needs one kill) for "Captured Doggebi"

stages.title: Stage 2 — Lv 51-52: One-armed Man + Forsaken Fort
stages.where: Out of town, then Forsaken Fort (out of town).

steps.text: Find "Giant Doggebi’s Broom" and 5x "Blood of Big Handed" from Giant Doggebis
Find Spirit of Doggebi of Monster Face, Spirit of Doggebi with a Gong, Spirit of Drunken Doggebi
Find Spirit of Doggebi with a Mask of Black Crow, Spirit of Doggebi with a Mask of Black Panther
Find Spirit of Giant Doggebi, Spirit of Guardian of Doggebi
Kill 10 each of Doggebi of Monster Face, Doggebi with a Gong, Drunken Doggebi, Doggebi with a Mask of Black Crow, Doggebi with a Mask of Black Panther, Giant Doggebi, Guardian of Doggebi

steps.label: Kill Chief of Angry Doggebi Troop (1x)

stages.title: Stage 3 — Lv 52-53: Manager’s errand + first Pub visit
stages.where: Out of town, then Fort → Pub of the Giant Bird.

steps.text: Find "Guardian of Doggebi’s Stone" and 5x "Water Dragon Blood" from Guardian of Doggebi
Find 5x "Skeleton Warrior’s Head" from Rotten Skeleton Warrior of the Royal Tomb

stages.title: Stage 4 — Lv 54-57: Tomb Keeper grind chain begins
stages.where: Pub of the Giant Bird — this NPC carries you for a while.

steps.text: Find 5x "Skeleton Warrior’s Ribs" from Rotten Skeleton Warrior of the Royal Tomb
Go to D1 and kill 20x each: Doggebi of Monster Face, Doggebi with a Gong, Drunken Doggebi, Doggebi with a Mask of Black Crow, Doggebi with a Mask of Black Panther
Find 5x "Royal Tomb Keeper’s Book" from Minister of the Royal Tomb
Get 5x "Speed up Medicine"
Kill 60x Rotten Skeleton Warrior of the Royal Tomb (Sword) + 60x (Lance)

quests.name: Event Quest 32

steps.text: Kill 100x Maid of Honor of the Royal Tomb

quests.reward: 12,000,000 XP, 5x Talisman of Defense, Artisan’s Fixing Tool

steps.text: Find 5x "Royal Tomb Keeper’s Lute" from Maid of Honor of the Royal Tomb
Kill 100x Minister of the Royal Tomb
Find 5x "Royal Tomb Keeper’s Sword" from The Royal Tomb Keeper

stages.title: Stage 5 — Lv 58: City of Priest opens up
stages.where: Pub of the Giant Bird, then City of Priest.

steps.text: Find 5x "Royal Tomb Keeper’s Shield" from The Royal Tomb Keeper
Get 5x "Baked Mackarel in Soy Sauce" — cook at the Fort with 1x Mackerel fish
Kill 60x The Royal Tomb Keeper (sword) + 60x (Shield)
Kill 60x The Royal Tomb Keeper (Iron Hammer) + 60x (Spear)
Kill 60x each: The Royal Tomb Keeper (sword), (Shield), (Iron Hammer), (Spear)

stages.title: Stage 6 — Lv 59-60: Tomb Keeper finale
stages.where: Pub of the Giant Bird.

steps.text: Find 5x "Royal Tomb Keeper’s Spear" from The Royal Tomb Keeper
Find 5x "Royal Tomb Keeper’s Iron Hammer" from The Royal Tomb Keeper

stages.title: Stage 7 — Lv 70: 3rd Job Change + Forest of Elements
stages.where: Fort → City of Priest → Forest of Elements (field) → City of Priest.

steps.label: Field
steps.name: Forest of Elements — drop 10x each: element of fire, water, wood, iron, ground (can substitute "Imperfect element of.." from the same mobs or from D5)

steps.label: Talk — convert imperfects (200k each try, ~35% success rate, not guaranteed)
Field
steps.name: Carry the converted elements to the altars at every major spot in the Forest of Elements

steps.label: Field
steps.name: "Monster’s Right Arm" from Demon Monster (D4, every floor)

steps.label: Field
steps.name: "Necklace of Evil" from Chief of the Traitor’s Hangout, Yoong-Gi (Highlands of Sky, Traitor Hang Out)

steps.label: Field
steps.name: "Lord’s Jaw" from Lord of Shadow Troop (D2)

steps.label: Field
steps.name: "Sword of the Chief Defender" from Twisted Demon Defender (Emok Island)

steps.label: Turn in — 3rd Job Change with new skills

steps.text: Find Souls of Undead from higher-level spirits / MK monsters in D5: Essence of earth (F3), wood (F4), water (F6), fire (F8), iron (F9)
"The Trial of I’Lryer" — go to D5, find 100x "Essence of Undead" (drops from all D5 mobs), and "I’Lryer’s ring" from Cheios/Dunamic on F10 or Illusion of Dunamic / Illusion of Cheios on F9 (R1/R2)

steps.label: Field
steps.name: Messenger of Devah [Jin-Heun] — Geum-Oh Mine, through the left gate, down the hill, keep right to the ramp

steps.text: Receive "Moving Trinket" — grants access to Valley of Devah

stages.title: Stage 8 — Lv 81: skill training
stages.where: City of Priest.

steps.text: Click "Receive Training" and pick one of 3 skills (OTP, EVA or DEF) — the skill level scales up with your character level, up to skill level 20

stages.title: Stage 9 — the AWAKEN trilogy
stages.where: Narootuh (talk point) → Emok Island → Valley of Devah farming.

quests.name: Event Quest — 1st AWAKEN

steps.label: Field
steps.name: "DEAD Hye min" — Narootuh, between NPC 43 and Refining Deamon Gong

steps.text: Kill 200x Twisted Deamon Officer of Attack + 200x Twisted Imperial Deamon Commander (Emok A9)
Find 20x "Mysterious Marble" + 5x "Piece of Shining Gold" from Shadow of D’evah

quests.reward: Blue Ball + access to 1st Awaken skills (S → Awaken tab)

quests.name: Event Quest — 2nd AWAKEN

steps.text: Find 2x "Gold Ingot" (craft with 200x Gold Coins at the Gold Master, dropped by Shadow of D’evah), 60x "Mysterious Marble", 15x "Piece of Shining Gold"

quests.reward: Pink Ball + access to 2nd Awaken skills (S → Awaken tab)

quests.name: Event Quest — 3rd AWAKEN

steps.text: Find "Processing Awaken Lv3" from D’evah Boss
Find 1x "Gold Ingot" (craft with 100x Gold Coins), 120x "Mysterious Marble", 30x "Piece of Shining Gold"

quests.reward: Yellow Ball + access to 3rd Awaken skills (S → Awaken tab)
